svg.title: RMR control panel names and terminals
svg.text: RMR control panel: names and terminals
Sheet 2C: what each name on sheets 1, 2A and 2B is and where it sits, and what lands on every terminal. The terminal plan is read from the wire lists that draw sheets 2A and 2B.

mains in: L, L, N, N, PE from the inlet
fuse holder, 1 A T: feeds the K1 rung
110 VAC contactor HC1-63: mains to the 24 V PSU,
door 110 V: out to S1 and H1 on the panel
4 ground blocks: inlet PE, PSU FG, door plate,
24 V 1200 W supply, lying flat, fan to the right
12-way fuse module: +24 V cut by the E-stop
24 V contactor BMC7-25U: 1-2 and 3-4 in series
feed FB2, 5-6 seal in, 7-8 tell Mega pin 43 that

feeds the Pi at the operator panel
lower PE bar on the base plate's PE stud

endstops: a signal and a common for each axis

lid (UV array, switch S5) and the argon valve

panel knob that switches K1 on; H1 its lamp, lit

lid switch in series with the UV array: closed =

Raspberry Pi 5 with the touch screen, runs
ODrive S1 spin coater drive; J11 is its UART

0V-P 1; PSU -V; 5 V PSU IN-; ground bar; servo PSU IN-
